description: This is a Perl script that acts as a helper command-line utility to control a Coocook instance within a Docker environment. It provides commands for deploying, serving, and displaying help information for managing the Coocook application.

methods.name: deploy
methods.description: Executes the deployment script with specified flags to manage the database of the Coocook instance.

methods.name: server
methods.description: Runs the server script with optional flags to start the local development server.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message string with red color.

methods.name: warning
methods.description: Returns a formatted warning message string with yellow color.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for different commands based on the argument.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides a help message on how to use the script.
